queries: WITH per AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS grp_avg FROM per) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, p.avg_mod - o.grp_avg AS excess_over_overall, p.avg_mod / o.grp_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.grp_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose signals all have NULL modindex are excluded from the per-telescope set, so they do not count in the overall mean of per-telescope averages.
The ratio is computed as the telescope's average divided by the overall average (the mean of per-telescope averages), and the excess is the difference between the two; no rounding is applied.

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose modindex values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the group average (mean of per-telescope averages over telescopes with at least one non-null modindex).
If the overall average is zero or negative, the ratio is not meaningful; modindex is assumed positive.
